content: The Dialog State Tracking Challenge (DSTC) datasets are another related resource. Specifically, DSTC 1 BIBREF12, DSTC 2 BIBREF13, and DSTC 3 BIBREF14 contain “chatbot style" queries, but the datasets are focused on state tracking. Moreover, most if not all queries in these datasets are in-scope. In contrast, the focus of our analysis is on both in- and out-of-scope queries that challenge a virtual assistant to determine whether it can provide an acceptable response.
